finalists.label: Myolipoma
finalists.why: It has a well-defined, soft mass with dilated surface veins and a homogeneous T1- and T2-hyperintense mass on MRI.

finalists.label: Fibroadenoma
finalists.why: It has a well-defined, soft mass with dilated surface veins, a heterogeneous lucent mass on mammography, and was encapsulated with multiple thin septa.

frontier_selector.why: Fibroadenoma is chosen because it has more specific findings, including a heterogeneous lucent mass on mammography and encapsulation with multiple thin septa, which are not shared with its rivals.
